newsitem.title: INDIA: India Tatas allay fears over chairman's health.
newsitem.headline: India Tatas allay fears over chairman's health.

text.p: India's largest business group, the Tatas, said on Thursday that rumours about company chief Ratan Tata's alleged ill-health were unfounded.
Tata is chairman of the Tata Iron and Steel Company Ltd. and the Tata Engineering and Locomotive Company Ltd., among others.
"Mr Tata is absolutely fine and attending to his normal routine," Tata Sons director S.A. Sabavala said in a statement.
Tata Sons is the group's holding company.
"Any statement to the contrary should be dismissed."
The rumours had triggered some nervous selling, traders said.
"These...seem to be arising out of some mischievous rumours that may have been spread in the market," the statement added.
